interface.name: ferese_effects_manager_v1

description.summary: assign semantic material roles to surfaces

interface.description: This private global is visible only to clients granted the Ferese effects capability. Roles describe compositor-owned appearance policy and do not expose shader parameters or backdrop content to the client.

request.name: get_surface_effects

description.summary: create semantic effects state for a surface

request.description: A wl_surface can have at most one live surface-effects object. Creating another object for the same surface is a protocol error.

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: the surface already has an effects object

interface.name: ferese_surface_effects_v1

description.summary: semantic material role for one surface

interface.description: The role affects only compositor rendering. It does not change surface geometry, input, focus, stacking, or the surface's Wayland role.

description.summary: clear the role and destroy this object

request.name: set_role
request.description: The most recent valid role replaces the previous role atomically.

request.name: set_regions

description.summary: restrict material to rounded surface-local rectangles

request.description: An array of native-endian IEEE 754 binary32 tuples (x, y, width, height, radius) in logical pixels. All values must be finite and have magnitude at most 32768; width and height must be positive and radius nonnegative. At most 32 rectangles are allowed. Invalid arrays are ignored. Coordinates are rounded only after output scaling. An empty array disables material painting without clearing the role. Surfaces which never send this request retain full-surface materials.

request.name: set_opacity
request.description: Opacity from 0 to 1000, including surface content, material and shadow. Values above 1000 are clamped. Input and geometry remain unchanged.

request.name: set_region_opacities

description.summary: fade individual region materials and shadows

request.description: An array of native-endian uint32 opacity values from 0 to 1000, indexed in set_regions order. Content is not affected. Missing entries use 1000. At most 32 entries are allowed; invalid arrays are ignored. These values multiply the surface opacity and persist until replaced.

request.name: set_presentation

description.summary: apply material presentation with the next surface commit

request.description: Queue the role, regions, surface opacity and region opacities together. They take effect on the next wl_surface.commit, with its content buffer. Array formats and limits match set_regions and set_region_opacities. Invalid arrays or roles leave the pending state unchanged. Surface opacity is clamped to 1000. The last valid request before a commit wins. Compositor-owned dismissal retains control of surface opacity.

request.name: set_panel_presentation

description.summary: commit a bounded panel shape with its content

request.description: Panel-only material presentation. Regions are bounded capture/damage rectangles in the set_regions format. Shapes are native-endian binary32 tuples (x,y,width,height,top-left,top-right,bottom-right,bottom-left, operation,blend-zone). Operations: 0 rounded union, 1 rounded cutout, 2..5 rectangular concave patches whose circle centers are bottom-left, bottom-right, top-right, top-left. Blend zones 1..3 fuse independently; zone 0 never fuses. At most 32 primitives and one cutout are accepted. All coordinates must be finite and bounded by 32768 logical pixels. Invalid requests leave pending state unchanged. Empty shapes require empty regions. Input remains controlled by wl_surface.set_input_region. This presentation becomes visible atomically with the next surface commit.
